metaDescription: Calculaderia's privacy policy. Learn how we handle your data and why we prioritize your privacy.
title: Privacy Policy
intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how Calculaderia handles your data.

noCollection.title: Browser-based calculations
noCollection.text: Simulations and calculations are still processed locally in your browser. To create an account, we only use Google sign-in.

localStorage.title: Saved favorites
localStorage.text: When you save a simulation to favorites, we store its name, calculator, and URL parameters in a database so they can be associated with your account.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: We use Google Analytics to understand how the site is used (pages visited, time spent). This data is anonymous and aggregated, not identifying individual users.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site uses essential cookies for authentication, language preference and, when configured, Google analytics. You can disable non-essential cookies in your browser settings.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: We use Google for authentication and Vercel for hosting. We recommend consulting those services' privacy policies to understand how they handle data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: This policy may be updated occasionally. Significant changes will be communicated on the main page or on this page.
